mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 3.5%) indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1200) reflect strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200 (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS > 1% MoM) and housing starts (HOUST > 1% MoM) indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1% MoM AND HOUST rises > 1% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS rises > 1% MoM and HOUST rises > 1% MoM (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.0%) indicates tight labor markets that fuel wage inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs zero).
